sections.夏日祭的尾声: The End of the Summer Festival

dialogue.引航者，今天晚上玩得开心吗？: Pilot, did you have fun tonight?
dialogue.不错不错，可惜今晚是夏日祭最后一天了，下一次就要等到明年了。: It was great, it's a shame tonight is the last day of the summer festival. We'll have to wait until next year.
dialogue.没关系呀，夏日祭结束了引航者又不会消失。引航者之后也会一直陪着我的，对吧？: It's okay, it's not like the Pilot will disappear when the festival ends. You'll keep staying with me afterwards, right?
dialogue.那是当然了，这个问题还用得着我回答吗？: Of course. Do you even need to ask?
dialogue.哈哈哈，引航者还真是个好搭档呢。: Hahaha, the Pilot really is a great partner.
dialogue.对了心夏，我有件事情想跟你说。: Hey Kokona, there's something I want to tell you.
dialogue.诶？这么突然吗，引航者说吧。: Eh? That's so sudden. Go ahead, Pilot.
dialogue.真的吗？我看看......哎，居然是夏日祭的周边吗？: Really? Let me see... Hey, these are summer festival goods?
dialogue.心夏打开看一眼。: Open it and take a look, Kokona.
dialogue.这是......我和引航者的合照！: This is... a photo of me and the Pilot!
dialogue.引航者真是有心啊，没有给引航者准备些礼物我都有点过意不去了。: The Pilot is so thoughtful. I feel bad for not having prepared a gift for you.
dialogue.不用不用，这只是一个小心意而已。: No need, it's just a small token of appreciation.
dialogue.好吧。引航者，我先去洗个澡再回来，等我一会哦。: Alright. Pilot, I'm going to take a bath first, wait for me okay?
dialogue.我知道了，我会等心夏的。: I understand, I'll wait for you, Kokona.
dialogue.还挺快的嘛，不愧是副队长前辈。: That was fast. As expected of the Vice-Captain.
dialogue.这.....这种时候就不要用这个称呼啦！: Th-that's... don't call me that at a time like this!
dialogue.算了算了，引航者，你过来，我也有句很重要的话要跟你说。: Forget it. Pilot, come here, I also have something very important to tell you.
dialogue.什么啊，难道心夏也给我准备了一份惊喜吗？: What is it? Did Kokona prepare a surprise for me too?
dialogue.其实我对引航者有一种不一样的情感呢，不只是最好的搭档。: Actually, I have different feelings for the Pilot. More than just being best partners.
dialogue.那我可以提一个小小的请求吗？: Then... can I make a small request?
dialogue.心夏以后有空的话可以多陪下我吗，感觉最近见面的时间越来越少了。: Kokona, can you spend more time with me when you're free? I feel like we've been seeing less and less of each other lately.
dialogue.啊..嗯，最近工作稍微忙一些，抱歉啊。: Ah.. yeah, I've been a bit busy with work lately. I'm sorry.
dialogue.不过我答应引航者，等我熬过这段困难时期，只要有空闲时间，我都会来找引航者的。: But I promise you, Pilot. Once I get through this tough period, whenever I have free time, I'll come find you.
dialogue.嗯，听心夏这样说我就放心了。: Okay, hearing you say that puts my mind at ease.
dialogue.欸...这个是之前萍安日那套衣服，引航者又重新弄了一套出来？: Eh... this is that outfit from Ping'an Day. Did the Pilot get another one made?
dialogue.是啊，心夏之前那套不是已经有点旧了吗，所以想给心夏换一套新的。: Yeah, the one you had before was getting a bit old, so I wanted to get you a new one.
dialogue.这样啊，我穿试试看。: I see. Let me try it on.
dialogue.还不错嘛，和之前的感觉差不多，多谢引航者啦。: Not bad. Feels about the same as before. Thanks, Pilot!
dialogue.嗯，心夏喜欢就好。: Good, I'm glad you like it.
dialogue.那是当然的了，我可喜欢引航者...送来的东西了。: Of course. I really love... the things the Pilot gives me.
dialogue.诶，引航者的反应怎么这么冷淡。: Hey, why is the Pilot's reaction so cold?
dialogue.没有吧，心夏应该没有那层意思吧？: No way. Kokona didn't mean it like that, right?
dialogue.时间也不早了吧。哈——唔，该休息的时候就该好好休息。: It's getting late isn't it. Haah... time to get some proper rest.
dialogue.心夏可别强撑着啊。我先回去了，心夏先好好休息吧。: Don't push yourself too hard, Kokona. I'll head back first. You get some rest.
dialogue.嗯。引航者明天可要记得来找我玩啊！: Okay. Pilot, remember to come see me tomorrow!
dialogue.知道啦。我走了，拜拜，晚安。: Got it. I'm leaving now. Bye, good night.
dialogue.嗯！引航者明天见，晚安～: Okay! See you tomorrow, Pilot. Good night~

narration.心夏低下了头，不过不到一秒她又把头抬起来了，并且笑嘻嘻地看着我。: Kokona lowered her head, but in less than a second she lifted it again, looking at me with a smile.
narration.能和她这样的女生待在一起，我真是幸运啊。: I'm really lucky to be able to spend time with a girl like her.
narration.过了大约一刻钟，心夏从浴室里出来了。: After about fifteen minutes, Kokona came out of the bathroom.
narration.她脸上泛起的红晕告诉了我她的想法。: The blush on her face told me what she was thinking.
narration.应该是我多虑了，她应该不是这个意思吧？: I must be overthinking it. She probably didn't mean it like that, right?
narration.与此同时，投影显示的时间变成了00:00。: At the same time, the projected time changed to 00:00.

choices.其实我有个一件小礼物想送给心夏: Actually, I have a small gift I want to give to Kokona
choices.其实我给心夏买了一套衣服来着: Actually, I bought an outfit for Kokona

choice_prompts.引航者要对心夏说什么？: What does the Pilot want to say to Kokona?
